mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN members AS B ON B.member_id = A.member_id WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND A.status = #{status}
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
AND B.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
ORDER BY A.created_at DESC

SELECT A.*, C.name as sido_name, B.name as sigungu_name,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetup_applications WHERE meetup_id = A.meetup_id ) AS participant,
DATE_FORMAT(meetup_At, '%Y.%m.%d') as fomatMeetupAt,
(SELECT E.image_path FROM images AS E JOIN meetup_images AS F ON E.image_id = F.image_id WHERE F.meetup_id = A.meetup_id ORDER BY E.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_path
FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN sigungus AS B ON B.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sidos AS C ON C.sido_id = B.sido_id LEFT OUTER JOIN categories AS D ON D.parent_id = A.category_id WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND C.sido_id = #{sidoId}
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
AND D.parent_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY
A.created_at ASC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_likes AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id GROUP BY A.meetup_id) DESC
A.meetup_At DESC
A.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{start}, ${end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN sigungus AS B ON B.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sidos AS C ON C.sido_id = B.sido_id LEFT OUTER JOIN categories AS D ON D.parent_id = A.category_id WHERE A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.status != 'DELETED'
AND C.sido_id = #{sidoId}
AND A.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchText}, '%')
AND D.parent_id = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY
A.created_at ASC
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetups AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN meetup_likes AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id GROUP BY A.meetup_id) DESC
A.meetup_At DESC
A.created_at DESC

SELECT A.*, B.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meetup_applications WHERE meetup_id = A.meetup_id ) AS participant, F.name as sido_name
FROM meetups AS A JOIN members AS B ON B.member_id = A.member_id JOIN sigungus AS E ON E.sigungu_id = A.sigungu_id JOIN sidos AS F ON F.sido_id = E.sido_id WHERE A.meetup_id = #{meetup_id}
SELECT C.image_path FROM meetups AS A JOIN meetup_images AS B ON B.meetup_id = A.meetup_id JOIN images AS C ON C.image_id = B.image_id WHERE A.meetup_id = #{meetupId}
